protocol.gate: At least 12 new Commons sharp and two new native generated sharp locations. At most two new untouched source flags and four total new ordinary flags, with every fixed-size incumbent location preserved.

rules.advance: At least five new small sharp locations in at least three groups. Preserve at least 85 percent of incumbent sharp locations and add no more than four net ordinary flags and no more than one on the untouched Commons views.
rules.point: Greater than the second-largest control maximum from eight separate source groups.
